How do I use it properly the very first time?
Using your fire pit for the first time is an exciting moment! Here’s a simple guide to get you started:
Choose the Right Spot: Place your fire pit on a flat, non-flammable surface. If you’re using the included stand, it will protect surfaces like grass, decks, or patios.
Gather Your Firewood: Use dry, seasoned hardwood for the best results. Start with 3–4 logs, keeping them close to the fire pit’s inner walls for an efficient burn. You can read more about preparing your wood here.
Start the Fire: Place a fire starter or kindling in the center of the fire pit, then stack your logs in a teepee or crisscross pattern over it. Light the fire starter, and let the airflow design of the fire pit do the rest.
Enjoy the Smokeless Flame: Once the fire is going, you’ll notice minimal smoke and a mesmerizing flame. Add more logs as needed, but avoid overloading the fire pit.
Cool Down Safely: When you’re done, let the fire burn out completely. The stainless steel will cool down quickly, but always ensure it’s safe to handle before moving or storing.
Clean Up: After the fire pit has cooled, empty the fine ash left behind. It’s easy to clean and maintain for your next use.
For more tips and safety instructions, you can explore our guide here. Enjoy your first fire and the memorable moments it brings!
